name: Havells Aquilla Dry Iron
subtitle: 1000W iron with non-stick soleplate
description: Havells Aquilla is a 1000W dry iron with an American Heritage non-stick coated soleplate, temperature control dial, and 360° swivel cord. Its aerodynamic plastic body, flat-type heating element, and button grooves support convenient everyday garment ironing.
story: Built for regular household ironing, the Havells Aquilla combines straightforward heat control with features designed around garment handling. Select the temperature according to the fabric using the easy-grip dial, while the non-stick coated soleplate is designed for smooth movement across clothes. The 360° swivel cord allows easier maneuvering as you change direction, and button grooves help work around shirt details. With its 1000W heating power and dry-iron design, it suits everyday shirts, uniforms, sarees, and other garments.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
